approval.notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-19 the Prompt U evidenced subset: 2,805 current + 11 historical offices (2,816 total) as drafted. Accepted-with-holds / approved subset only. HOLD: 308 communes without executive-body evidence (VD 284, SZ 24); thin historic/merger office archive (586 historical geographies vs 11 historical offices); 1,938 communes without positive elected-parliament evidence (citizen-assembly caveat); mode-variance / disputed result rows as open research notes. Full-register certification remains OPEN. Standing policy: retain offices and historic rows even outside the ~18-month alert window. Do not invent the 308 missing commune executives or fabricate merger histories. No Switzerland importer, electiondatabase redirects, or Mexico changes in this landing.

schema_compatibility_note: national maps to schema v1 national_context. council is unused legacy vocabulary; no row emits it. unknown maps to NULL/unknown, never other. Focused-review flags stay on drafted rows and do not un-accept the evidenced subset. Full-register certification remains OPEN.

importer_policy.note: No Switzerland Atlas importer in this landing. A future separately authorized importer may load the 2,816 accepted evidenced offices. Do not invent the 308 missing commune executives or fabricate merger histories. Full-register certification remains OPEN.

national maps to national_context; regional/municipal/other unchanged. Unknown is never other by coercion.

No office inferred solely from a commune geography; missing body research is an open gap. Do not invent the 308 missing commune executives or fabricate merger histories.
Standing policy: retain offices and historic rows even outside the ~18-month alert window.
